signals.title: Codex makes browser and native-app authority a managed policy layer with approval lifetimes
signals.title_zh: Codex 将浏览器与原生应用权限提升为带 Approval Lifetime 的受管策略层
signals.summary: OpenAI's September 3 Codex update gives enterprise administrators browser website defaults and exceptions, upload/download/history/developer-access restrictions, controls for automatic review and saved approvals, explicit approval lifetimes, and native-app allow/block rules.
signals.summary_zh: OpenAI 9 月 3 日的 Codex 更新让企业管理员能够配置 Browser Website Default/Exception、Upload/Download/History/Developer Access 限制、Automatic Review 与 Saved Approval 控制、显式 Approval Lifetime，以及 Native App Allow/Block Rule。

researchValue.failure: Per-site or per-app approvals can silently become indefinite authority when duration, destination class, and managed policy are not first-class runtime facts.
researchValue.mechanism: Separate browser and native-app policy defaults/exceptions from individual approvals, and bind saved approvals to an explicit lifetime under administrator policy.
researchValue.implication: Enterprise digital-employee runtimes should model browser/app authority, destination exceptions, and approval TTL independently from the immediate tool prompt.

signals.title: GitHub separates Copilot's approval judgment from authority to sign off a pull request
signals.title_zh: GitHub 将 Copilot 的 Approval Judgment 与实际 PR Sign-off Authority 分离
signals.summary: GitHub now lets Copilot code review provide an approval assessment on every review while keeping actual pull-request sign-off disabled by default and subject to explicit enterprise, organization, or repository administrator authorization.
signals.summary_zh: GitHub 现在允许 Copilot Code Review 在每次 Review 中给出 Approval Assessment，但真正的 Pull Request Sign-off 默认关闭，只有 Enterprise、Organization 或 Repository 管理员显式授权后才可生效。

researchValue.failure: An AI reviewer can be treated as having merge-governance authority merely because it can produce an approval-like judgment.
researchValue.mechanism: Keep assessment generation always available while separately gating the authority to create an approval that participates in repository merge policy.
researchValue.implication: Digital employees should separate recommendation or judgment from the organizational authority that turns the judgment into an effective approval.

signals.title: Codex versions root authorization evidence so a cached Guardian allow cannot outlive changed authority
signals.title_zh: Codex 对 Root Authorization Evidence 版本化，防止 Cached Guardian Allow 越过权限变化继续生效
signals.summary: Codex retains root instructions and verified answers for delegated Guardian reviews, versions that authorization evidence so an allow result is cancelled when the evidence changes, recovers it across parent compaction, and strips parent-only Guardian approvals when worker history is forked.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 为 Delegated Guardian Review 保留 Root Instruction 与 Verified Answer，对这组授权证据进行版本化，使 Evidence 变化时既有 Allow Result 自动失效；同时支持 Parent Compaction 后恢复，并在 Worker Fork 时剥离 Parent-Only Guardian Approval。

researchValue.failure: A cached allow can remain effective after root instructions or verified answers change, or a parent-only approval can accidentally become child-local authority after a worker fork.
researchValue.mechanism: Version the root authorization evidence used by review, invalidate allows when its version changes, preserve required evidence across compaction, and remove parent-only approvals on fork.
researchValue.implication: Long-running multi-agent runtimes should version authorization evidence and treat compaction and fork as authority-sensitive transitions rather than transparent context operations.

signals.title: Claude Code treats remote permission, stop, and offline delivery as host-owned session state
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将远程 Permission、Stop 与离线 Delivery 作为 Host-Owned Session State
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.261 fixes Remote Control so attached phone/browser clients reflect the terminal's current permission mode, remote Stop interrupts the actual turn, and messages to an offline remote session report queued delivery instead of falsely appearing delivered.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.261 修复 Remote Control：手机/浏览器接入后显示 Terminal 当前真实 Permission Mode；远程 Stop 会中断实际 Turn；向离线 Remote Session 发送消息时明确显示 Queued，而不是误报 Delivered。

researchValue.failure: A remote operator surface can project stale permission, completion, or delivery state and thereby mislead the human about what the execution host is actually doing.
researchValue.mechanism: Treat the execution host as the owner of permission, turn lifecycle, and delivery state, and project those facts to remote clients instead of letting the client infer success locally.
researchValue.implication: Mobile and web control surfaces for digital employees should be projections of host-owned runtime facts, not independent chat-state replicas.

signals.title: Gemini CLI requires consent before extensions mutate the runtime environment
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 在 Extension 改变 Runtime Environment 前要求显式 Consent
signals.summary: Gemini CLI now prompts for consent when extensions change environment variables and sanitizes runtime-altering environment variables, making extension installation or activation distinct from permission to alter the execution environment.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 现在会在 Extension 修改 Environment Variable 时请求 Consent，并清理会改变 Runtime 行为的环境变量，从而把 Extension 安装/启用与修改执行环境的权限明确分开。

researchValue.failure: An installed extension can acquire indirect execution power by mutating loader, proxy, path, or toolchain environment without a distinct authorization event.
researchValue.mechanism: Detect extension-driven environment changes, require explicit consent, and sanitize variables that can alter runtime execution semantics.
researchValue.implication: Agent plugin systems should treat environment mutation as a separate privileged capability rather than an incidental side effect of plugin configuration.

signals.title: MCP Python SDK restricts endpoint redirects to the original trust origin
signals.title_zh: MCP Python SDK 将 Endpoint Redirect 限定在原始 Trust Origin 内
signals.summary: The MCP Python SDK now follows redirects only within the MCP endpoint's origin, constraining discovery and transport redirects so endpoint trust does not silently expand to another origin.
signals.summary_zh: MCP Python SDK 现在只允许在 MCP Endpoint 原始 Origin 内跟随 Redirect，把 Discovery/Transport Redirect 限制在既有 Trust Boundary 内，避免端点信任静默扩展到其他 Origin。

researchValue.failure: An authenticated or trusted MCP endpoint can redirect a client across origins and thereby transfer endpoint trust, credentials, or session semantics to an unintended destination.
researchValue.mechanism: Permit redirect following only when the target remains inside the original MCP endpoint origin.
researchValue.implication: Protocol clients should bind redirect authority to the admitted endpoint trust scope instead of treating HTTP redirect as neutral transport behavior.

signals.title: A reproducible study evaluates agentic Julia code generation under parallel and scalable supercomputing constraints
signals.title_zh: 一份可复现研究在并行与可扩展超算约束下评估 Agentic Julia Code Generation
signals.summary: The Zenodo artifact studies agentic code generation in Julia on supercomputers using an agent extended with Julia documentation that autonomously plans, generates, and refines code through tool use, shifting evaluation beyond single-shot generation toward parallel and scalable execution constraints.
signals.summary_zh: 该 Zenodo Artifact 研究 Julia 在 Supercomputer 上的 Agentic Code Generation：Agent 接入 Julia Documentation 后通过 Tool Use 自主规划、生成并迭代代码，把评估从 Single-Shot Generation 扩展到并行与可扩展执行约束。

researchValue.failure: Code-generation benchmarks can overstate engineering readiness when they measure only one-shot correctness and omit the agent's iterative tool-use behavior and the generated program's scaling constraints.
researchValue.finding: The artifact evaluates an autonomous plan-generate-refine loop for Julia code in a supercomputing setting rather than limiting assessment to single-shot output.
researchValue.mechanism: Use a reproducible agent loop and HPC execution setting to evaluate generated code under parallel and scalability constraints.
researchValue.implication: Agentic software-engineering evaluation should record tool-mediated refinement and operational scaling evidence separately from code-generation accuracy.
